writeup.headline: S&P +2.1% at Lunch; Technology Leads
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Nvidia's CEO Scandal Widens, Chip Rivals Jump Instead. The AI names are up and the average stock is up: stocks are moving together. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.
